## Checklist

- [ ] Commits include DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Table tests cover the change (positive and negative), each case cites its source.
- [ ] Goldens updated with `-update` and checked by hand.
- [ ] `docs/spec/v0.1.md` and `docs/diagnostics/` updated when behavior or codes change.
- [ ] Value mappings and catalog entries cite public, pinned sources.
- [ ] No secret, template body or user value can reach the output.
